_readme: Webpage URL-extraction sanity cases (GitHub Pages). Built by build_cases.py from webpage_url_extraction_test_cases(1).md + base-href resolution cases. Per case: 'present' = absolute URLs that must appear in the antispam-log urlList; 'presentTemplate' = same with {BASE} (full deploy base incl. /repo) / {ORIGIN} (scheme+host only) placeholders; 'absent' = must NOT appear; 'info'=true -> log only. generate.py wraps page.html into a static page under the given path.

cases.desc: Every relative shape against one <base href>.
